title: Should we eat ultra-processed food?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What makes ultra-processed food so attractive even when people know it may be unhealthy?
Is the problem the food itself, or the amount and frequency with which we eat it?
Should warning labels on highly processed foods be stronger and clearer?
How realistic is it for busy or low-income families to avoid ultra-processed food?
What convenience food would be hardest for you to give up?
